chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 candidate_13 is a feasible optimized current lowest-cost candidate; S2 all candidates are optimized if relevant or screened by the declared lower-activity/higher-price rule; S3 highest-activity candidate_04 differs from candidate_13 and BACKWARD plus TEST_REACHABILITY have been executed, yielding an unreachable classification. Remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value: exact validity checks and MC are unaffordable, while further refinement would not change the screened dominance logic or the >1e12/unreachable parity conclusion.

unresolved_decision_risk.process_window_risk: Candidate_13 was optimized in targeted windows rather than the full domain. Remaining risk is small-to-moderate that an untested full-domain state could further lower candidate_13 cost; this would strengthen, not weaken, the choice. Risk that candidate_04/05 beat 15.29 USD/t in untested warm-separation regions is low given their core costs and cost pools, but not exactly eliminated by a full-domain optimization.
unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty_risk: All descriptors have declared uncertainty, with candidate_13 normal sigma 0.227 eV and most others uniform half-width 0.15 eV. MC uncertainty analysis was unaffordable within remaining budget, so probability of lowest cost under descriptor uncertainty was not quantified.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_validity_risk: Exact CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY edge/dominance checks cost 28 CU and were unaffordable with the remaining budget. Bed volume for candidate_13 has substantial cap slack (17.06 vs 90 m3), so bed-cap risk is low. Vessel-floor risk for tiny-bed high-activity candidates was not exactly checked, but it would mainly affect candidates already more costly than candidate_13.
